rules.Public: Only explicitly release-approved evidence, summaries, interfaces, claims and projections.
rules.Internal: Approved operational/canonical content for internal Desktop/Drive; not public Git/web projection unless separately promoted.
rules.Restricted: Need-to-know internal governance, authority topology, security controls, unpublished model internals and sensitive operational state; never public projection.
rules.Secret: Credentials, keys, tokens and secret material; local secure storage only.

public_projection_allow: approved evidence states and provenance summaries
public_projection_deny: unpublished Raphael equations, internal hypotheses or speculative tables
publication_rule: Public projection is a derived lens. Absence from public output does not delete internal state; internal state does not become public because a model can read it.
evidence_rule: Release class and evidence state are orthogonal. VERIFIED content may still be Restricted; Public content may still be labelled MODELLED/PROPOSED where explicitly approved.
fail_behaviour: If release class is missing or ambiguous for sensitive governance/Raphael material, treat as Internal/Restricted and HOLD automatic publication.
